question: How many open shipping-related support tickets do our strategic accounts have in total?

input.purpose: Check tier values in Salesforce accounts and active record handling
input.sql: SELECT tier_c, _fivetran_active, is_deleted, _fivetran_deleted, COUNT(*) AS n FROM salesforce.account GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n DESC

input.purpose: Check Zendesk ticket status, type and priority values
input.sql: SELECT status, type, priority, _fivetran_deleted, COUNT(*) AS n FROM zendesk.ticket GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n DESC

input.purpose: See which tags exist on tickets
input.sql: SELECT tag, _fivetran_deleted, COUNT(*) AS n FROM zendesk.ticket_tag GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 100

input.purpose: Inspect Zendesk organizations and how they might map to Salesforce accounts
input.sql: SELECT o.id, o.name, o.external_id, o._fivetran_deleted, a.id AS sf_id, a.name AS sf_name, a.tier_c, a.sap_customer_number_c, a._fivetran_active FROM zendesk.organization o LEFT JOIN salesforce.account a ON (o.external_id = a.sap_customer_number_c OR lower(o.name)=lower(a.name)) ORDER BY o.id

input.purpose: List all Salesforce accounts with tier and history flags
input.sql: SELECT id, name, sap_customer_number_c, tier_c, region_c, _fivetran_active, is_deleted, _fivetran_start, _fivetran_end FROM salesforce.account WHERE tier_c='Strategic' OR _fivetran_active=false ORDER BY name, _fivetran_start

input.purpose: Pull open tickets for current Strategic accounts with tags and subjects
input.sql:
WITH strat AS (SELECT DISTINCT id, name, sap_customer_number_c FROM salesforce.account WHERE tier_c='Strategic' AND _fivetran_active=true AND _fivetran_deleted=false),
org AS (SELECT o.id AS org_id, o.external_id, s.name, s.sap_customer_number_c FROM zendesk.organization o JOIN strat s ON o.external_id=s.id WHERE o._fivetran_deleted=false)
SELECT org.name, t.id, t.status, t.priority, t.type, t.subject, t.created_at, string_agg(tt.tag, ',') AS tags
FROM zendesk.ticket t JOIN org ON t.organization_id=org.org_id
LEFT JOIN zendesk.ticket_tag tt ON tt.ticket_id=t.id AND tt._fivetran_deleted=false
WHERE t._fivetran_deleted=false AND t.status IN ('new','open','pending','hold')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY org.name, t.id

input.purpose: Count open shipping-related tickets for current Strategic accounts using tags OR subject keywords, to cross-check the manual count
input.sql:
WITH strat AS (SELECT DISTINCT id, name FROM salesforce.account WHERE tier_c='Strategic' AND _fivetran_active=true AND _fivetran_deleted=false),
org AS (SELECT o.id AS org_id, s.name, s.id AS sf_id FROM zendesk.organization o JOIN strat s ON o.external_id=s.id WHERE o._fivetran_deleted=false),
t AS (SELECT t.id, t.status, t.subject, org.name AS account, org.sf_id,
  (SELECT string_agg(tag, ',') FROM zendesk.ticket_tag tt WHERE tt.ticket_id=t.id AND tt._fivetran_deleted=false) AS tags
  FROM zendesk.ticket t JOIN org ON t.organization_id=org.org_id WHERE t._fivetran_deleted=false AND t.status IN ('new','open','pending','hold'))
SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_tickets_all,
 SUM(CASE WHEN (tags LIKE '%shipping%' OR tags LIKE '%delivery%' OR tags LIKE '%logistics%' OR tags LIKE '%late_delivery%' OR lower(subject) SIMILAR TO '%(late|delay|tracking|delivery|not received|left your warehouse|still missing)%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shipping_related,
 SUM(CASE WHEN (tags LIKE '%shipping%' OR tags LIKE '%delivery%' OR tags LIKE '%logistics%' OR tags LIKE '%late_delivery%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tag_only,
 SUM(CASE WHEN status='open' AND (tags LIKE '%shipping%' OR tags LIKE '%delivery%' OR tags LIKE '%logistics%' OR tags LIKE '%late_delivery%' OR lower(subject) SIMILAR TO '%(late|delay|tracking|delivery|not received|left your warehouse|still missing)%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS status_open_only,
 SUM(CASE WHEN account LIKE 'Halbrook Fluid Systems GmbH%' AND (tags LIKE '%shipping%' OR tags LIKE '%delivery%' OR tags LIKE '%logistics%' OR lower(subject) SIMILAR TO '%(late|delay|tracking|delivery|not received|left your warehouse|still missing)%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS halbrook_gmbh_shipping,
 COUNT(DISTINCT sf_id) AS accounts_with_open
FROM t

input.purpose: Recheck subject-keyword matching for untagged open tickets of Strategic accounts using ILIKE
input.sql:
WITH strat AS (SELECT DISTINCT id, name FROM salesforce.account WHERE tier_c='Strategic' AND _fivetran_active=true AND _fivetran_deleted=false),
org AS (SELECT o.id AS org_id, s.name, s.id AS sf_id FROM zendesk.organization o JOIN strat s ON o.external_id=s.id WHERE o._fivetran_deleted=false),
t AS (SELECT t.id, t.status, t.subject, org.name AS account,
  (SELECT string_agg(tag, ',') FROM zendesk.ticket_tag tt WHERE tt.ticket_id=t.id AND tt._fivetran_deleted=false) AS tags
  FROM zendesk.ticket t JOIN org ON t.organization_id=org.org_id WHERE t._fivetran_deleted=false AND t.status IN ('new','open','pending','hold'))
SELECT id, status, subject, COALESCE(tags,'') AS tags,
 (subject ILIKE '%late%' OR subject ILIKE '%delay%' OR subject ILIKE '%tracking%' OR subject ILIKE '%delivery%' OR subject ILIKE '%not received%' OR subject ILIKE '%left your warehouse%' OR subject ILIKE '%still missing%') AS subj_match,
 (COALESCE(tags,'') ILIKE '%shipping%' OR COALESCE(tags,'') ILIKE '%delivery%' OR COALESCE(tags,'') ILIKE '%logistics%') AS tag_match
FROM t ORDER BY subj_match DESC, tag_match DESC, id

input.purpose: Check how recently the Zendesk ticket, tag and Salesforce account tables were synced
input.sql: SELECT 'zendesk.ticket' AS src, MAX(_fivetran_synced) AS last_synced, MAX(updated_at) AS max_business_ts FROM zendesk.ticket UNION ALL SELECT 'zendesk.ticket_tag', MAX(_fivetran_synced), NULL FROM zendesk.ticket_tag UNION ALL SELECT 'salesforce.account', MAX(_fivetran_synced), MAX(last_modified_date) FROM salesforce.account

answer.answer_summary: Our current Strategic accounts have 28 open shipping-related support tickets in total, across 16 accounts. "Open" means Zendesk status new, open, pending or hold; only 13 of the 28 are in status "open" itself. Halbrook Fluid Systems GmbH contributes 2 of the 28 and may be a duplicate account, so the total could be 26 if it is removed.

metrics_used.name: Strategic account
metrics_used.definition: salesforce.account rows with tier_c = 'Strategic', _fivetran_active = true and not deleted (26 rows); accounts linked to Zendesk organizations via external_id = Salesforce account id

metrics_used.name: Open ticket
metrics_used.definition: zendesk.ticket with status in ('new','open','pending','hold') and not deleted

metrics_used.name: Shipping-related ticket
metrics_used.definition: open ticket carrying a shipping, delivery, logistics or late_delivery tag, OR whose subject mentions late, delay, tracking, delivery, not received, left your warehouse or still missing

lineage: salesforce.account -> current Strategic account list (active, tier_c = Strategic)
zendesk.organization (external_id = Salesforce account id) -> account to organization map
Count of open shipping-related tickets for Strategic accounts = 28
assumptions: Strategic accounts are the 26 active Salesforce records with tier_c = 'Strategic' as of 6 Nov 2026. Thalmark Marine, Velmere Pipeline and Vornwick Utilities were promoted to Strategic on 2026-09-22 and are included. Quenmere Paper Mills was demoted and is excluded.
'Open' includes Zendesk statuses pending and hold as well as new and open, because all four are unresolved. Solved and closed tickets are excluded.

Shipping-related means a shipping, delivery, logistics or late_delivery tag, or a subject about late/delayed/missing/untracked orders. Tags are incomplete: 5 of the 28 have no tag and were included on subject alone.

'Delay on bearings for line 8396' (102956) is counted as shipping-related because the subject describes a delivery delay. It is the only one of the 28 with no tag that is less clear-cut; excluding it gives 27.

Halbrook Fluid Systems GmbH (Salesforce 001KHodrD6UyqZnaQR) has no SAP customer number and is treated as a separate account because it has its own Zendesk organization. It may be a duplicate of Halbrook Fluid Systems.
caveats: If only status 'open' counts (excluding pending and hold), the total is 13, not 28.
If Halbrook Fluid Systems GmbH is a duplicate of Halbrook Fluid Systems, the total falls to 26.

Sync timestamps in Zendesk and Salesforce (9 and 11 Nov 2026) are later than the 6 Nov as-of date, so the sync clock may be off. The most recent ticket update is 3 Nov 2026, so data_age_days of 3 reflects that update, not a confirmed sync time. Whether the data is current is therefore unconfirmed (is_current left null).
Tag coverage is incomplete, so the subject-keyword rule is needed. Ticket subjects are free text and could be misclassified.
The question asked only for the total, so no at-risk account list was produced.

explanation.title: Missed a customer split across two CRM accounts
explanation.detail: Halbrook Fluid Systems has a look-alike duplicate account ("… GmbH") with no SAP number. Two of its open shipping tickets sit on the duplicate, so the customer looked healthy.

explanation.title: Read every history row of the account tier
explanation.detail: salesforce.account keeps one row per version of each account (history mode). Without filtering to _fivetran_active, accounts that changed tier appear twice, and Quenmere Paper Mills GmbH still looks Strategic.
